Commentary.Commentary: We are back. Sri Lanka players now take the field. Followed by the opening pair of Pakistan, Abdullah Shafique and Imam-ul-Haq to take on the new ball. Asitha Fernando to start with the ball.
... Day 1, Session 3 ...

The visitors were excellent with the ball. It was Naseem Shah and Shaheen Afridi who ran a havoc at the start. They picked up three and one wickets respectively. Abrar Ahmed then join them and ended with a four-fer. Pakistan bowlers have done their job and that too really well. The onus is now on the batters to put up a mammoth total and put the hosts under pressure. The conditions though are not that easy. The Lankans have struggled and so will the Pakistan batters. Will the Lankan bowlers get the early wickets? Or will Pakistan continue its dominance? We will find out soon. Join us in a bit for the Pakistan innings...

SESSION SUMMARY - 22.4 overs, 87 runs, and 6 wickets. That was certainly a poor display of batting from the Lankan side. They have been bowled out for 166 runs. The fifth-wicket partnership of 86 between Dhananjaya de Silva and Dinesh Chandimal was the only crucial partnership for them. The formar was dismissed by Abrar Ahmed while Chandimal fell on a short ball from Naseem Shah. Only four of the Lankan batters went into double digits, rest all were dismissed on a single digit. They will be certainly hoping for their bowlers to recover from this damage.

... DAY 1, SESSION 2 ...

The home side will be upset with how things panned out in this session. Their made some wrong short selections and kept on losing wickets. They are currently reeling on 79-4 and Dinesh Chandimal and Dhananjaya de Silva will look to steady the sinking ship and build up a gritty stand for their side. Can they do it? Or will the visitors continue to dominate? To find out, do join us at 1.10 pm IST (7.40 am GMT) post lunch break.

SESSION SUMMARY - 26 overs, 79 runs, and 4 wickets. A session that was dominated by the visitors. They will be the happier side going into the break. The pitch certainly had something for the pacers and Shaheen Afridi and Naseem Shah made the most of it. They kept on picking wickets at regular intervals and kept on building the pressure on the Lankans. Naseem Shah picked up two wickets while Shaheen Afridi chipped in with one. They were excellent with their fielding as well with Shan Masood dismissing Nishan Madushka via a direct hit.

Commentary.Commentary: We are all set. The players and the umpires are out in the middle. Nishan Madushka and Dimuth Karunaratne are the openers for Sri Lanka. Shaheen Afridi to start with the new ball. Let's play...
PITCH REPORT - The pitch here is a good batting pitch and there is a nice bit of grass. We might get some seam movement but it won't last long. The team winning the toss should bat first.
Babar Azam the skipper of Pakistan says that they would have batted first as well. Adds that they are confident in this game and ends by saying that they will go with the same side.

Dimuth Karunaratne the skipper of Sri Lanka says that they will bat first. Adds that they know its a good batting pitch and they will look to make the most of it. Ends by mentioning two changes in their side and says that Dilshan Madushanka makes his debut.
Pakistan (Unchanged Playing XI) - Abdullah Shafique, Imam-ul-Haq, Shan Masood, Babar Azam (C), Saud Shakeel, Sarfaraz Ahmed (WK), Agha Salman, Nauman Ali, Shaheen Afridi, Aamer Jamal, Naseem Shah.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Nishan Madushka, Dimuth Karunaratne (C), Kusal Mendis, Angelo Mathews, Dinesh Chandimal, Dhananjaya de Silva, Sadeera Samarawickrama (WK), Ramesh Mendis, Prabath Jayasuriya, Dilshan Madushanka (In for Vishwa Fernando), Asitha Fernando (In for Kasun Rajitha).
TOSS - Sri Lanka have won the toss and elected to BAT first.
The update from the middle is the toss will happen at 10 am IST (4.30 am GMT) and the match will start at 10.30 am IST (5 am GMT).

Update 9.42 am IST (4.12 am GMT) - Well, there there was rain earlier here at Sinhalese Sports Club, Colombo. The good news is that it has stopped now. The toss has been delayed. Stick around for more updates.

The home side fought hard in the first one. The Prabath Jayasuriya-Ramesh Mendis duo were excellent. The side would look for a better performance from their batters in this game. Pakistan, on the other hand, would be happy as Saud Shakeel continued to shine and scored a double century. They would look to clean sweep the series now. Can they do it? Let's find out. Toss and team news in a bit...

Hello and a warm welcome folks! It is time for the second Test of this two-match Test series between Sri Lanka and Pakistan. The Lankans would look to win this and level the series as they had lost the first one. Pakistan, on the other hand, wouldn't make it any easy for them. This promises to be a cracking encounter and let's see how things pan out.
